description: Runs a command remotely on a container within a task.

incidents.description: Tracking TeamPCP: Investigating Post-Compromise Attacks Seen in the Wild

securityImplications: Attackers might use ExecuteCommand to run commands inside a running ECS container through the ECS Exec feature, using the container's task role to explore the environment, read secrets, and move laterally.
